question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**revengeful**" means eager to exact revenge. (प्रतिशोधी)
 
• Example: The government carried out revengeful attacks in response to the opposition's criticisms.
 
• In the context of the passage,** "revengeful" **fits **best **as it describes the government's actions against the severe criticisms targeting the demonetization decision.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**' i.e. 'revengeful'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Severe criticisms were made to target the decision. The government also carried out revengeful__ attacks.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ineffectual (अप्रभावी)**: Not producing the desired effect. 

 
 
• **Example:** All his efforts proved ineffectual in achieving the desired outcome.
 
 
 
• **Case (मामला)**: An instance of a particular situation. 
 
 
• **Example:** This case calls for careful consideration and judgment.
 
 
 
• **Example (उदाहरण)**: A representative case or instance. 
 
 
• **Example:** This story serves as an example of true bravery.
